You are a fix worker patching the PRODUCTION Mott booking gateway file. OFFLINE: no network, no git, no MCP, no skills; write only in your working directory. This code answers a live patient SMS line - precision over cleverness; smallest possible delta.

PATCH BASE (the exact file running in production, extracted from the live image): /home/ankit114/repos/ringer/my-manifests/mk2-number-and-comeback/workGWfix/gw-prod-extract/bland_gateway_prod.py. Key functions: resolve_relative_date (vocabulary patterns; bare-weekday branch), extract_date_from_text (free-text scan; candidate windows), resolve_from_conversation (chooses latest user message).

PROVEN DEFECTS TO FIX (all evidence executed tonight): (D1) resolve_relative_date has no pattern for '(the) following <weekday>' - falls to bare-weekday, so 'the following thursday' on Mon 2026-08-03 gave 08/06 instead of 08/13; live probes also show weekday-dependent incoherence (following Monday/Tuesday/Wednesday/Saturday resolved NEXT week, Thursday/Friday/Sunday THIS week). (D2) extract_date_from_text reduces multi-token phrases to a one-token weekday window, so even with D1 fixed the wrong candidate can win. (D3) a leading corrective 'No' ('No the following Thursday' after an offer) must select the replacement phrase, not kill it - production resolved it to 08/06 (controlled live replay on record).

WRITE ./bland_gateway_fixed.py: a full copy of the patch base with EXACTLY these changes: (1) in resolve_relative_date, immediately BEFORE the generic bare-weekday branch, add a pattern matching optional 'the ' + 'following ' + weekday name, resolving to the named weekday of the NEXT calendar week (Monday-anchored - identical semantics to the existing '<weekday> next week' handling; reuse its helper, e.g. calendar_weekday(weekday, 1)). (2) in extract_date_from_text, ensure a recognized multi-token following-weekday expression occupies its span and is selected in preference to any one-token weekday window inside it. (3) correction-context negation, SCOPED NARROWLY: only when a user message matches the grammar ^no[,!. ]+(the )?following <weekday>\b (case-insensitive, allowing trailing words like 'please' or 'works') does the leading no NOT negate the phrase - it selects the following-weekday resolution. Phrases like 'no friday works', 'no not thursday', 'nothing on friday' must keep their current behavior exactly. Touch nothing else - no reformatting, no import changes, no logging changes beyond what the three fixes require.

ALSO WRITE ./run_proof.py (offline, deterministic, no network): imports BOTH the original patch base and your fixed copy via importlib from absolute paths, stubbing the deployed-only sibling capability_registry in sys.modules first (QueryError as Exception subclass, other imported names as no-op callables; see working pattern in /home/ankit114/repos/ringer/my-manifests/mk2-number-and-comeback/workT1fix/t1-repro-fixer/repro.py). Freeze time per case. It must print machine lines for three proofs: (P1) the 12-case corpus /home/ankit114/repos/ringer/my-manifests/mk2-number-and-comeback/workT1r3/t1-final-analysis/eval_cases.json through the FIXED resolve path (correction cases through the message-shape path like production) - one CASE line each and 'P1_EXT=<x>/12' (target 12/12). (P2) regression sweep: every phrase from the golden generator /mnt/d_drive/repos/mott/gw-temporal-check/gen_golden.py (study it; use its phrase sets including dangerous_none) run through ORIGINAL vs FIXED resolve_relative_date AND extract_date_from_text; print one 'P2_DIFF phrase=<...> orig=<...> fixed=<...>' line per behavioral difference and 'P2_DIFFS=<n> P2_UNINTENDED=<m>' where unintended counts diffs NOT matching the following-<weekday>/correction grammar (target m=0; every dangerous_none phrase must stay None under FIXED unless it matches the narrow correction grammar exactly). (P3) incident replay: /home/ankit114/repos/ringer/my-manifests/mk2-number-and-comeback/workT1r3/t1-prefix-run/messages_prefix.json through the FIXED resolve_from_conversation with now frozen to 2026-08-03T16:58:00-04:00; print 'P3_INCIDENT=<mm/dd/yyyy|NONE>' (target 08/13/2026).

Run ./run_proof.py yourself and save its full output as ./PROOF.txt. Iterate until P1_EXT=12/12, P2_UNINTENDED=0, P3_INCIDENT=08/13/2026. If any target is genuinely unreachable, stop and write why into PROOF.txt rather than loosening a check. VERIFY also: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -m py_compile bland_gateway_fixed.py. Final message <=15 lines.
